text:
Hi Larkspur team,

Hope you're all doing great. I'm reaching out because I'm looking to hire the 1961 Hartwell Kestrel for my daughter's wedding - big occasion, lots of excitement. We were thinking of picking it up on 19th March 2027 at 11.30am and bringing it back on Sunday 21 March 2027 at 18:00. I was wondering if you could bring it to Studio 9, Quarry Lane and collect it from there afterwards? We would really appreciate it if we could have it with a chauffeur. I've attached my driving licence, so you can verify everything is in order. 

Looking forward to hearing back from you.
Nell Quillfeather
+70 871 323 2419
